presentation.name: Write an EDA report a later dashboard can be based on
presentation.summary: Writes what a dataset is and which questions it can support, so a later dashboard has something to be based on.
benefits: States the grain, the time coverage and the unit of each measure before a chart is chosen
Labels each relationship as declared or inferred, and leaves an inferred join inferred
Ties a question the dataset cannot support to a missing column, a broken grain or a quality finding
Cites the quality assessment instead of computing the null and duplicate rates a second time
